A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Training-Free Safe Denoisers for Safe Use of Diffusion Models. All 24 pages, including Appendices A–E, support comparison through text extraction and visual inspection.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E report original image-generation experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations, runtime measurements, and qualitative results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including text-to-image safety evaluations, ImageNet class negation, and FFHQ generation experiments.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same unsafe-denoiser approximation, penalty weight, timestep and threshold controls, and integrations with SAFREE and SLD.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same I2P, CoPro, adversarial-prompt, COCO, ImageNet, and FFHQ/CelebA-HQ coverage. The memorization example and long-prompt evaluation are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: ESD, RECE, SLD, and SAFREE participate in the same text-to-image comparisons, while Sparse Repellency remains the comparator for class-conditional and unconditional generation.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–E retain identical models, sampling procedures, dataset selections, sample counts, and metrics, including the 50-step text-to-image protocol and 50,000-sample ImageNet evaluation.

E4.justification: The weight illustration, unsafe-set-size and threshold ablations, long-prompt aesthetic analysis, memorization example, and qualitative case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the aesthetic-score values with ± terms in Table E.2. No run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and E.1–E.2 retain the same numerical entries, and the plots and qualitative examples match. For example, Table 2 reports MMA-Diffusion ASR of 0.481 for SLD+Ours and 0.469 for SAFREE+Ours in both versions.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, Theorem 3.2, the mathematical derivations, and the complete Appendix A proof are unchanged. Extraction differences around mathematical symbols reflect spacing rather than revised reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free safety guidance, theoretical grounding, compatibility with existing methods, and empirical effectiveness.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same safety–quality interpretations, explanations of Sparse Repellency artifacts, and limitations concerning hyperparameter tuning and access to representative unsafe data in Section 6 and Appendix B.

D1.justification: Hardware, kernel bandwidths, scaling factors, timestep ranges, reference-image construction, and model/dataset access information are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same statements about supplementary images and their planned repository release.

R1.justification: The same 56 references and research positioning are retained, including the comparisons with Sparse Repellency, Diffusion Soup, and Dynamic Negative Guidance.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v3, 12 June 2025, to v4, 9 October 2025. Otherwise, the wording, section order, terminology, and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Visual inspection confirms the same figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, and page placement throughout. Tiny text-rendering differences do not change the displays or document layout.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the same method, proof, empirical evidence, explanations, and limitations, including the appendices. The updated arXiv stamp and negligible rendering differences do not materially improve or diminish clarity, rigor, or reproducibility.
